quest.title: Empty Abode
quest.description: Assailed by many enemies, you realize that this road will not be an easy one. The way into Stormterror's Lair is strewn with obstacles, and so you must proceed with caution to find a path along the ruined walls.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Mora x8775, Adventurer's Experience x3, Fine Enhancement Ore x10

chapter.title: Song of the Dragon and Freedom

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like this is the front gate to <color=#00E1FFFF>Stormterror's Lair</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's stuck.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: It's stuck.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, check out that <color=#00E1FFFF>roof</color>. Is there a giant <color=#00E1FFFF>hole</color> in it?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hmm... I suppose we could make use of that <color=#00E1FFFF>wind current</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's make a detour then. Heading up!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Let's make a detour then. Heading up!

talks.objective: Find a way through the wind barrier

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Do you think there will be Abyss Mages hiding in the ruins?

talks.objective: Look for a way to the top of the tower
Go towards the top of the tower

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look! A <color=#00E1FFFF>wind current</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Oh, we can't advance any further. The ruins seem to be guarded by ancient <color=#00E1FFFF>seals</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this the work of Dvalin?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: No. These ruins were once part of an ancient city. Dvalin just happens to be nesting in these ruins for now.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: These ruins even predate the existence of The Four Winds.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Mondstadt is a city without a ruler. However, before it was...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: It was ruled over by a tyrant.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Anyway... I'll sing you that story when we have a chance in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: The markings on this seal... If my archaeological knowledge is not mistaken, this appears to be a <color=#00E1FFFF>light actuator</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: If we retrieve and <color=#00E1FFFF>reintegrate</color> all the <color=#00E1FFFF>parts</color>, we should be able to <color=#00E1FFFF>get it working</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: We should be close to completing the ceremony for this actuator.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Let's put the <color=#00E1FFFF>last part</color> back and see.
